authorInfo.bio:
Charles-François Tiphaigne de La Roche (1722–1774) wrote Giphantia
Or a View of What Has Passed, What Is Now Passing, and, During the Present Century, What Will Pass, in the World.. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
